subtitle: 800 illustrated winter-shelter companions for Not By Chance Outreach.
campaign: Chia Winter Outreach Generative NFT Fundraiser

chip0007.collection_id_note: This is the CHIP-0007 collection UUID (off-chain metadata grouping). It is NOT a Chia launcher ID, DID, NFT ID, or mint address. Those are assigned later.

naming.description_template: Warm Company #{token_id:04d} is a {family_name}, an illustrated {class_label} created for the Not By Chance Outreach winter campaign. This NFT symbolically represents one {represents_lower} the campaign intends to purchase. It does not convey legal title to a specific physical item.

title_candidates.name: Warm Company
title_candidates.why: Company means companionship and a company of characters. Warm is the mission. Reads well on a marketplace. Does not punch down.

title_candidates.name: Camp Kind
title_candidates.why: Short, outdoor, moral without being syrupy.

title_candidates.name: Eight Hundred Warm
title_candidates.why: Leads with the 1:1 count. Very campaign-forward. Slightly less character-forward.

title_candidates.name: Shelter Kin
title_candidates.why: Family of objects. Risk: 'shelter' can sound institutional.

title_candidates.name: First Light Camp
title_candidates.why: Dawn motif already in the art direction. More poetic, less literal about the 800 items.

family_names.note: Pup is outdoor vocabulary (pup tent), not a cute-animal costume. Lodge reads as the larger gathering tent.

production_seed.note: Replace with a freshly generated production seed before Phase 11. Store the production seed offline as well as in config once locked. Never rotate after final generation.

urls.note: Do not invent public URLs, IPFS CIDs, or on-chain identifiers. Fill these only when they exist.
